svg.title: Faultline bond flow
svg.desc: Eight steps of a Faultline earthquake cat bond: setup, investors buy, risk period, earthquake, oracle attests, challenge window, payout, maturity, with side branches for no earthquake and trustee veto.

g.text: Bond + pool created, sponsor funds coupon
KYC'd, stablecoin in, bond units out
Applies locked rule, signs, logs on HCS
One tx: sponsor paid, holders written down
